title: A night in the Mai Chau valley
summary: One night in a White Thai stilt house in Lac, a bicycle on the valley paths, and dinner at the house.

days.title: Day 1 — Evening on the floor
days.body: Sleep in Lac, or in Pom Coong if that is the house. After dinner the floor is White Thai music and dance. A start time is Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 2 — Morning in the rice
days.body: Walk the lanes while they are quiet, then bicycle the paths between the houses and the paddies. Breakfast is the house table, including rice from the bamboo tube. A loop hour is Check on arrival.

stops.name: Lac village
stops.note: Spend the night in a stilt house and bicycle the valley paths in the morning.

stops.name: Bamboo sticky rice
stops.note: Eat bamboo-tube rice at the house in the morning.

stops.name: Hill chicken
stops.note: Eat hill chicken at the house in the evening.

stops.name: Jar wine
stops.note: Have jar wine with the evening at the house.

additions.name: Pom Coong
additions.note: Sleep here when the night is not in Lac.

seoTitle: A night in the Mai Chau valley
seoDescription: One night in a White Thai stilt house in Lac and a morning on the valley paths. Dinner is the house.
